d:
In this episode of Guest in the Newsroom, veteran actor Paresh Rawal joins Saurabh Dwivedi for a wide-ranging conversation. From theatre to Bollywood blockbusters like Uri: The Surgical Strike, Welcome, Hera Pheri, and OMG: Oh My God!, Paresh Rawal has delivered unforgettable performances across decades.
In this interview, he talks about the evolution of Indian cinema, his journey through theatre and shares his thoughts on favoritism in award shows. He also opens up about Aamir Khan, Naseeruddin Shah, Akshay Kumar, Irrfan Khan, Salman Khan, and Shah Rukh Khan.
